answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond whose slashable value grows with activity, so fake accounts cost real capital before earning trust. Like a vine drawing nectar from scarce soil, reputation flows only through verified, costly history, not free signups. On a frozen tundra of cloned identities, the attacker must fund every fake bond simultaneously, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
